question: Which accessible public ADP and projection sources identify their format, platform, sample and update date?
evidence_needed: Read original methodology and current update; distinguish projections from ADP.

reviews.summary: Completed the dated source audit in docs/season-2026/public-adp-and-projections.md. Fantasy Football Calculator identifies 2026 12-team PPR and non-PPR mock-draft samples with August 24–31 windows. ESPN's Mike Clay guide states an August 31 update and 17-game baseline; complete scoring remains unverified. FantasyPros public HTML exposes a projection update and dated ADP providers, but several sample/roster assumptions remain incomplete and its Standard Scoring link leads to half-PPR defaults. Scripted FFC access returned HTTP 403; no automatic ADP integration is claimed. These findings answer source discovery, not every operational or scoring limitation.

question: Which current aggregate trend leaders have independently verified role or availability changes?
evidence_needed: Specific dated official team reports; do not infer a cause from aggregate counts.

reviews.summary: Investigated seven team situations in research/2026/2026-08-31-preseason-draft-brief.md using original team sources. The reports establish selected Dallas, Green Bay, Detroit, Cincinnati, Carolina, New Orleans and Tampa Bay roster/availability facts. Detroit's backup-role premise remains conditional. These facts provide context for selected aggregate leaders, not proof of trend causation or future workloads. Other leaders and game-week availability remain unverified, so the question stays open.
